left_out: the notes don't explain it: None of the commentary notes explain what tossing a sandal over Edom means. Matthew Henry only says David looks on Moab, Edom and Philistia as already his, because God promised him victory over his enemies. Calvin points to Psalms 57 and 60 without explaining it. Keil and Delitzsch only discuss Hebrew wording, and Adam Clarke's note is about a different line. The idea of a slave, taking land, or trampling is not in the notes.
